Since OpenSSL 4.2, EVP_MAC_update(), EVP_MAC_final() and EVP_MAC_finalXOF()
fail on a context that has not been initialised, or that has been finalised
and not re-initialised since. Previously results of such calls were undefined.
+Whether a key supplied with EVP_MAC_CTX_set_params() left the context usable
+without a call to EVP_MAC_init() was up to the implementation before
+OpenSSL 4.2; it now always initialises the context.
